Need swift to exist after here--->After blocks priority window

Need sluggish to exist after here---> Combat

                       After combat

author: calebgannon
content:
Swift damage <- All columns that hit here are marked as "swift"
After swift priority<- remaining columns will deal normal damage unless sluggish (even if given swift in this step, they didn't hit for swift damage and aren't marked as swift)
Normal damage <- All columns that hit here are marked as "normal"
Before sluggish priority <- remaining columns will deal sluggish damange here (even if given swift or sluggish is removed here, they didn't hit for swift or normal damage)
